item.title: METR: Independent Assessment of AI R&D Acceleration at Anthropic in October 2026
item.description: After 11 weeks inside Anthropic, METR estimates AI capabilities are improving about twice as fast as in 2024-25, with AI itself behind roughly 80% of the speedup — but Anthropic redacted most of the evidence that convinced them.

item.title: Terry Tao (guest post): What should we teach our (undergraduate) students?
item.description: With AI doing the routine math, what should undergraduates actually learn? A case for teaching judgment, proof, and problem-framing over calculation.
